deep_description:
This block defines configuration variables that may be used throughout the application. 'MAX_TOKENS' and 'TEMPERATURE' are set to control aspects of the text processing or model behavior, although they are not directly used in the provided code. These variables can be adjusted for different processing needs.

Components:
- MAX_TOKENS_variable: Defines a constant for the maximum number of tokens to be processed.
- TEMPERATURE_variable: Defines a constant for the temperature parameter, which may control randomness in text generation.
